meta.name: One Pace – The Adventures of Buggy's Crew
meta.description:
Buggy, after being defeated by Luffy, Zoro, and Nami, begins his quest to regain his body parts and his crew, and then he will get his flashy revenge on Luffy.

Arc 7 din One Pace: 1 episoade, capitole 35–75 cover stories. Acoperă episoadele One Piece 46–47. Subtitrare în română.
